arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Ae'grom{/c} now passively spawns a Vile Child {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} every {c_number}[SF_0|1|]{/c} seconds and deals {c_number}[{SF_7}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage with its cleave attack.

{c_important}Command Ae'grom{/c} no longer spews Vile Children and instead causes all of your {c_important}Lesser Demons{/c} to explode, dealing {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_EXPLOSION_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.
Increased Vile Child spawn rate by {c_number}[{SF_1}*100|%|]{/c}.
